reason: Adds a separate DeepSeek Harness settings tab that groups plugins by trust tier and provides searchable, sortable per-plugin details.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置中提供独立的增强插件列表标签页，按信任层级分组并支持搜索、排序和查看插件详情。
summaries.en: Adds a separate enhanced plugin-list tab to DeepSeek Harness settings with trust-tier grouping, search, sorting, and detailed plugin information.

capabilities: Reads the DeepSeek Harness Loader tree and installed package metadata
Serves a local plugin-list data route
Registers an additional settings plugin-list tab
Displays, filters, sorts, and groups plugin details
